lines.trans: Your house is here?
Do you live here too, noona?
No, not me, my boyfriend.
He is doing 2 Days and 1 Night right now.
By the way, where did you get assigned?
It hasn't come out yet.
Really? Come on over. I am there.
I tend to give up quickly if I think it's not meant to be.
Honestly, I was surprised when I saw you this afternoon.
Because I am human too.
But now I am really totally fine,
I hope the two of you have a beautiful love.
